title: The Chest for the Temple Repairs
reflectionText: When the first arrangement did not produce repairs, Jehoash and Jehoiada established a visible chest, counted the funds, and placed payment in faithful hands. The offering money still kept its distinct purpose. What does this careful procedure show about directing shared resources toward needed work?
editorialNotes: Packet 019 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within 2 Kings 12:4-16 and preserves the initial priest-managed collection, the replacement chest procedure, payments to workers, and the separate trespass and sin money.
